name: Fried Eggs
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Melt the butter in the pan over low to medium heat.
Crack open the eggs into the pan and let fry until the yolks begin to harden at the edges (indicated by a lightening in the yolk color).
Using the spatula, flip the eggs over and allow to cook 10 seconds for over-easy, 30 seconds for over-medium, or up to 1 minute for over-hard.
Add salt and pepper to taste, and serve.

culture.text: A fried egg is a dish made from one or more eggs which are removed from their shells, placed into a frying pan and cooked. They are traditionally eaten for breakfast or brunch in many countries but may also be served at other times of the day.
